target.title: fix(ui): preserve lobster vigil reactions
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

A shy lobster can be present solely because a busy run crossed the ten-minute vigil threshold. On busy-to-idle, the component cleared that sole presence owner after starting the terminal act, so reconciliation immediately erased the success cheer or failure droop and sent the lobster away. Browser-cancelled pointer gestures also left the press-and-hold timer alive, allowing a delayed pet after the interaction had ended.

Closes #103475. Follow-up to #103344; includes the pass-through visitor behavior landed in #103352.

## Why This Change Was Made

The component now gives a vigil terminal reaction an explicit, temporary presence owner. That owner is released when the act completes, the page hides, or another condition forces departure. Existing scheduled-visit and offline presence owners remain unchanged. The existing hold-cancel handler is also wired to `pointercancel`.

## User Impact

Long-running shy pets now visibly cheer, droop, or acknowledge an abort before performing the normal leave transition. Cancelled touch/stylus interactions cannot trigger a delayed pet. Seeded stranger/crab visitors and reduced-motion behavior are unchanged.

## Evidence

- Test-first red proof on Testbox-through-Crabbox lease `tbx_01kx5bm2mkz25zph154e850eem`: exactly the new pointer-cancel and vigil-only success/error regressions failed; 36 existing tests passed.
- Focused post-fix proof: `pnpm test ui/src/components/lobster-pet.test.ts`, 40/40 passed, including success, error, abort, pointer cancel, stranger, crab, and reduced-motion cases.
- `pnpm format:check -- ui/src/components/lobster-pet.ts ui/src/components/lobster-pet.test.ts`: passed.
- Hosted `pnpm check:changed -- ui/src/components/lobster-pet.ts ui/src/components/lobster-pet.test.ts`: passed, including core/core-test typechecks, lint, and repository guards.
- Fresh autoreview: clean, no actionable findings, confidence 0.87.
- Landing is intentionally held until #103393 and #103457 complete, followed by one final rebase and exact-head CI.
